offering_description.value: Sells electricity and natural gas to residential, commercial and industrial customers in several US states, delivering it over owned generation, transmission and distribution systems.

primary_services.value: electric and gas delivery; gas transportation and storage; utility infrastructure construction

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential electric and natural gas customers; B2B: commercial and industrial customers, wholesale power buyers

end_markets.value: residential and commercial energy; industrial manufacturing; oil and gas production; mining

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: customers pay for metered electricity and natural gas usage under regulated rates; project or contract: long-term wholesale power and gas supply contracts
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs power plants, transmission lines, distribution networks and gas pipelines, sells energy to end customers; service provider: takes in fuel and purchased power, delivers energy to customers and bills for usage

geography_served.value: US regional: South Dakota, Wyoming, Colorado, Iowa, Nebraska, Montana, Kansas and Arkansas

specialization.value: related lines: electric utility, natural gas utility, power generation and gas storage businesses that share customers and infrastructure

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct billing and service relationships with residential and business customers; own locations: company customer service offices and local operations centers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: rates and service approved by state public utility commissions, wholesale and transmission rules set by FERC, reliability standards from NERC
